notes.grounding: Nearly every claim checks out against the script: the argument loop at lines 544-562, the unconditional exit 0 at line 587, OVERALL_PERCENTAGE initialised to 100 at line 67 and recomputed only in calculate_spec_completeness, so --file mode would always pass, the bc guard, set -euo pipefail, the exit-1 usage errors, the existing vitest file using spawnSync, and validate.sh using 2 for validation and 3 for system errors. One misplacement: tasks.md T007 puts the exit-code comment block in the header, but it trails the file at lines 589-591, and the header Options comment at line 8 is not named as needing the new flag.
notes.requirements: REQ-001 to REQ-006 are testable and cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N, byte-identical text and JSON output, and invalid, out-of-range and missing values exiting 1 with no report. The --file decision is settled in plan and risks.
notes.verification: No task ends with a Verify: clause. T001-T007 carry no check at all. T008-T010 are verification tasks, but they name no exact command (no vitest invocation) and no expected output beyond prose.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1 and leaves no unfilled tokens. Generic template filler remains in plan.md section 2 ('Tests passing (if applicable)').
notes.consistency: Ids, paths and exit codes agree across the three files. spec.md REQ-006 calls the exit-code comment block trailing, tasks.md T007 calls it the header's. spec.md section 7 says the --file decision is carried by REQ-001 and REQ-002, but neither states it explicitly.
notes.clarity: The selector, the gate placement, the $# guard against set -u and the regex validation are concrete enough to implement without asking a question.
